openai.notes: The Data retention UI value None is not treated as Zero Data Retention. Provider abuse-monitoring, human review, deletion workflow, DPA, backups, subprocessors, and contractual terms remain separate verification fields.

anthropic.notes: No new production request should be routed to Anthropic after the Issue #669 migration. Historical provider copies, usage records, stored outputs, logs, and provenance can still exist and must retain truthful provider attribution.

systems.trigger: Automatic before covered public content, reply, profile text, or private message is stored/sent after deterministic rule checks

dataClasses.privateRoom: only where a caller uses this shared safety policy; private Room-specific exclusions must be assessed per route

systems.permissionChecks: Occurs inside authenticated write route after route/account permissions; deterministic safety rules run first
systems.outputDestination: Allow/warn/block decision to calling server route
systems.firstPartyRetention: Rule/AI warn-block safety events can retain bounded content previews plus provider/model/category metadata; allow outcomes are not stored as full content by the AI safety module
systems.humanAccessReview: No pre-publication human review for ordinary calls; moderation/audit operations can review recorded safety events
systems.fallbackFailure: OpenAI-only and fail-closed: provider unavailability returns block/unavailable rather than failing open
systems.userControls: Member can revise/retry; universal appeals workflow is not claimed
systems.changeNotification: Provider/model/prompt/failure-policy changes require Trust and Safety, registry, and AI Notice review

systems.trigger: Eligible thesis owner explicitly requests one analysis

systems.firstPartyRetention: floor_thesis_analyses plus source thesis; provider/model returned with analysis
systems.humanAccessReview: Member requests analysis; output is critique only and structurally excludes rating/recommendation fields
systems.fallbackFailure: No alternate provider; controlled timeout/provider error
systems.userControls: Thesis-owner initiated, once per thesis; no buy/sell/hold rating or price target
systems.changeNotification: Provider/model/prompt/schema changes require registry, financial-safety, and AI Notice review

systems.trigger: Search request

systems.trigger: Discussion display/ranking surfaces that use Signal

systems.humanAccessReview: No human confirmation; score is a signal, not truth/quality adjudication
systems.userControls: Underlying activities can change score; no claim of objective truth
systems.changeNotification: Formula changes require registry and public AI/automation disclosure review

systems.trigger: Conversation Intelligence request

systems.humanAccessReview: No human confirmation; candidate rank is selection signal only
systems.fallbackFailure: Conversation Intelligence becomes unavailable if RPC fails
systems.userControls: Source links make surfaced candidates traceable
systems.changeNotification: Candidate formula changes require registry review
